messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a rear-view dolly-in shot that moves from full-body to upper-body framing. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the video's camera setup to a rear-view dolly-in shot that moves from full-body to upper-body framing. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands in profile, then turns her back to the camera while raising her hands to adjust her hair buns.","camera":"The camera starts at a medium distance in profile and gradually moves closer, ending in a close-up of the character's back and head.","clothing":"A short, blue and white patterned dress with a low open back and cut-out shoulders, paired with light-colored flat sandals.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Hair is styled into two high buns on top of the head.","identity":"A slender female character with a stylized, computer-generated appearance.","scene":"An outdoor city street with cobblestone paving, brick buildings with storefronts, and vintage-style street lamps under an overcast sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output starts from a wider full-body side/rear view matching the reference street and subject placement, then moves closer to the character's back and head, ending in upper-body framing. The character's blue hair, dress, hair-adjusting action, and street scene remain broadly consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the camera to a rear-view dolly-in from full-body to upper-body framing, using the reference for initial direction, placement, and framing while preserving the person, action, scene, and timing.
uncertain: Exact preservation of facial expression cannot be fully verified because the face is mostly turned away or obscured in both videos.
unexpected_changes: The initial framing is more side/profile than a pure rear view, though it quickly becomes rear-facing as the character turns and the camera approaches.
